meraProtocol.bgRefreshCloudIos: Mera gets new articles while the app is closed and starts ranking them for you. Your phone decides when this happens. It may not run in Low Power Mode or when Background App Refresh is off. Uses some battery and data, and up to half of your daily article limit. This doesn't change Backup. Nothing is shared beyond what Mera already uses when the app is open.
meraProtocol.bgRefreshCloudAndroid: Mera gets new articles while the app is closed and starts ranking them for you. Your phone decides when this happens. It may not run when Battery Saver is on. Uses some battery and data, and up to half of your daily article limit. This doesn't change Backup. Nothing is shared beyond what Mera already uses when the app is open.
meraProtocol.bgRefreshOnDevice: Mera gets new articles while the app is closed. Your phone ranks them when you open the app. Uses some battery and data, and up to half of your daily article limit. This doesn't change Backup.
